histogram: list[int], length 256 (count of each byte value 0x00-0xFF in the whole file)
byteentropy: list[int], length 256 (byte counts in a 16 x 16 grid of window entropy bin by byte high nibble, flattened row by row)

strings.numstrings: int (number of printable ASCII strings at least 5 characters long)
strings.printabledist: list[int], length 96 (count of each printable character 0x20-0x7F across all strings)
strings.printables: int (total number of printable characters across all strings)
strings.entropy: float (Shannon entropy in bits of the printable character distribution)
strings.string_counts: dict[str, int] (pattern name to the number of strings matching it; only patterns with at least one match appear, out of 76 possible names)

general.entropy: float (Shannon entropy in bits per byte of the whole file, 0-8)
general.is_pe: int (1 if pefile parsed the file as a PE, else 0)
general.start_bytes: list[int], length 4 (first 4 byte values of the file)

coff.timestamp: int (link time as a Unix timestamp, set by the linker)
coff.machine: str (target CPU type name, e.g. IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386)
coff.number_of_sections: int (number of entries in the section table)
coff.number_of_symbols: int (number of entries in the COFF symbol table)
coff.sizeof_optional_header: int (size of the optional header in bytes)
coff.pointer_to_symbol_table: int (file offset of the COFF symbol table, 0 if none)
coff.characteristics: list[str] (file characteristic flags that are set, IMAGE_FILE_ prefix removed, e.g. EXECUTABLE_IMAGE)

optional.major_image_version: int (image version set by the developer, major part)
optional.minor_image_version: int (image version set by the developer, minor part)
optional.major_operating_system_version: int (minimum required OS version, major part)
optional.minor_operating_system_version: int (minimum required OS version, minor part)
optional.major_subsystem_version: int (minimum required subsystem version, major part)
optional.minor_subsystem_version: int (minimum required subsystem version, minor part)
optional.sizeof_code: int (total size of code sections in bytes)
optional.sizeof_headers: int (combined size of all headers in bytes)
optional.sizeof_image: int (size of the loaded image in memory in bytes)
optional.sizeof_initialized_data: int (total size of initialized data sections in bytes)
optional.sizeof_uninitialized_data: int (total size of uninitialized data sections in bytes)
optional.sizeof_stack_reserve: int (stack memory to reserve in bytes)
optional.sizeof_stack_commit: int (stack memory to commit at start in bytes)
optional.sizeof_heap_reserve: int (heap memory to reserve in bytes)
optional.sizeof_heap_commit: int (heap memory to commit at start in bytes)
optional.base_of_code: int (RVA where the code section starts)
optional.base_of_data: int (always 0; the extractor never fills this field)
optional.section_alignment: int (alignment of sections in memory in bytes)
optional.checksum: int (image checksum from the header, 0 if not set)
optional.number_of_rvas_and_sizes: int (number of data directory entries the header declares)
optional.dll_characteristics: list[str] (DLL characteristic flags that are set, IMAGE_DLLCHARACTERISTICS_ prefix removed, e.g. NX_COMPAT)

dos.e_magic: int (DOS signature; always 23117, the bytes MZ)
dos.e_cblp: int (bytes on the last page of the file)
dos.e_cp: int (number of pages in the file)
dos.e_cparhdr: int (size of the DOS header in paragraphs)
dos.e_lfarlc: int (file offset of the relocation table)
dos.e_lfanew: int (file offset of the PE header)

section.entry: str (lowercased name of the section holding the entry point, or of the first executable section; empty string if none)
section.sections: list[object] (one entry per section in the section table)

sections[].name: str (section name, lowercased, trailing null bytes removed)
sections[].size: int (size of the section on disk in bytes, SizeOfRawData)
sections[].entropy: float (Shannon entropy in bits of the section data, 0-8)
sections[].vsize: int (size of the section in memory in bytes, VirtualSize)
sections[].size_ratio: float (on-disk section size divided by file size)
sections[].vsize_ratio: float (on-disk section size divided by in-memory size)
sections[].props: list[str] (section characteristic flags that are set, IMAGE_SCN_ prefix removed, e.g. MEM_READ)

overlay.size: int (bytes appended after the last section, 0 if none)
overlay.size_ratio: float (overlay size divided by file size; written as int 0 when there is no overlay)
overlay.entropy: float (Shannon entropy in bits of the overlay data; written as int 0 when there is no overlay)

imports: dict[str, list[str]] (imported DLL name to the functions imported from it; functions imported by ordinal appear as DLL:ordinalN)
exports: list[str] (exported function names; exports by ordinal appear as ordinalN)
datadirectories: list[object] (element 0 holds relocation flags, then one entry per data directory the header declares, up to 16, in fixed order EXPORT through RESERVED)

datadirectories[0].has_relocs: int (1 if the file has base relocations, else 0)
datadirectories[0].has_dynamic_relocs: int (1 if the file has dynamic relocations, else 0)

datadirectories[1:].name: str (data directory name, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_ prefix removed, e.g. IMPORT)
datadirectories[1:].size: int (size of the data directory in bytes)

richheader: list[int] (Rich header values in pairs: a compiler or tool ID, then its use count)

authenticode.self_signed: int (1 if any certificate before the last in a signature has the same issuer and subject, else 0)
authenticode.empty_program_name: int (1 if any signature has no program name, else 0)
authenticode.no_countersigner: int (1 if any signature has no countersigner, else 0)
authenticode.parse_error: int (1 if the signature data could not be parsed, else 0)
authenticode.chain_max_depth: int (largest number of certificates in any one signature)
authenticode.latest_signing_time: float (latest countersignature time as a Unix timestamp; written as int 0 when there is no countersignature)
authenticode.signing_time_diff: float (countersignature time minus the COFF timestamp, in seconds; written as int 0 when there is no countersignature)

pefilewarnings: list[str] (pefile parser warnings, each normalized to a template from pefile_warnings.txt)
